verdict.rationale: Pomelo is API-first: its own API reference covers core operations such as creating digital accounts and authorizing and adjusting transactions, and adjustments arrive through an API endpoint. However, nothing documents parity with the Dashboard, and some features appear UI-only, such as the transaction simulator (hosted at dashboard-stage) and Dashboard operator role management, with no documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API equivalents for Dashboard-only features (operators/roles/permissions, monitoring, simulator), a downloadable spec to verify coverage, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
